visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white historical-style engraving depicting a central elderly figure seated on a large rock, surrounded by a group of Indigenous people in a camp setting. The central figure wears an ornate headdress and robes. Several figures stand around him, one kneeling at his feet, while a larger crowd of people and several conical tents are visible in the background.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Engraving, rock, conical tents, headdresses, robes, weapons (tomahawks/knives), grass, crowd of people.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: An elderly man seated in the center, several men standing around him in traditional attire, one man kneeling, and a large gathering of people in the background.
visualDescription.uncertaintyNotes: The specific historical identity of the figures is based on the provided caption, but the artistic representation is a 19th-century interpretation and may not be historically accurate to the actual individuals or events depicted.

suggestedMatch.exactSourceQuotation: Then permitting his looks to wander over the silent throng that crowded around the elevated seat of Tamenund, he first perceived Hawkeye in his bonds.
suggestedMatch.modelRationaleNotVerified: The scene description matches the gathering around Tamenund, the elderly leader seated on an elevated rock (often depicted as a throne or prominent seat in illustrations of this chapter), surrounded by a crowd of Indigenous people, with tents and camp settings typical of the Delaware village described in this sequence.

visualCrosscheck.specificVisibleEvidenceNotHumanVerified: The engraving shows an elderly seated figure identified as Tamenund surrounded by Indigenous people and a large crowd with tents in the background.
